## Contributor checklist

- [ ] This change is isolated from WAM Core consensus and frozen upstream baselines.
- [ ] No real keys, credentials, wallet state, private logs or sensitive test artifacts are introduced.
- [ ] No skipped or weakened security check is disguised as a pass.
- [ ] Third-party code and license notices are documented where needed.
- [ ] Changes are ready for maintainers to review. Draft PRs do not request automatic merge.

**For vulnerabilities:** please follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) instead of reporting an exploit here.
